name: nicks-plugins
description: Small plugins and mods for Claude Code: like a buddy for your session and a Pokéball above the prompt.

plugins.name: pokepal
plugins.description: A Pokémon pal for your session (Fuecoco, Mimikyu, Pumpkaboo, Drifloon): a side pane and a mini strip above the prompt.

plugins.name: pokeball
plugins.description: A Pokéball above the prompt that wobbles while Claude works and clicks shut when a turn completes.
